thread:
Jorge (release-manager): Quick check — cutoff for v1.8.0 is T+36h. Any blockers? We need: version bump PR, final changelog polish, and green canary. Can we still hit Wed EOD?
Alex K: I opened the version bump PR just now -> #4123. 
Alex K: It's just the tag + changelog entry. CI currently running.
Maria P: changelog has two missing items under 'SDK': auth refresh fix and new timeout param. I added notes in the PR but need someone to sanity-check phrasing.
Sam R: failing test in integration suite on mainnet fixture — looks like a flaky teardown, investigating. Could be 30-60m.
Cheng L: Heads up, infra quota warnings for the canary GPUs earlier today. I bumped quota request but not approved yet. If quota not ready we may need to delay canary or use a smaller pool.
Jorge (release-manager): @Sam R thanks — can you patch the flaky test as a tiny PR if it's quick? If not, we'll back out that test from the canary run.
Sam R: yeah I'll attempt a fix now. If I can't, I suggest we pin the canary model to v1.7.3 so product isn't exposed to the integration noise.
Alex K: If we pin the canary we should still merge the version bump to avoid mismatched tags. I can hold the final merge until canary passes.
Maria P: I can take a pass on wording in changelog in ~20m. Will @Alex then squash the changelog commits?
Jorge (release-manager): Plan suggestion: hold merge until canary green. If infra quota blocks canary, then announce a 24h slip and do a hard freeze on new feature merges. Thoughts?
Cheng L: If we announce slip we should give an ETA and reason (quota + flaky test). Ops will need ~4-6h to provision fallback GPUs in other region.
Alex K: CI Bot shows branch coverage up but one lint failure in docs. I'll fix that in the version PR.
CI Bot: [automated] CI queued: #4123 — unit: pass, integ: running, lint: fail (docs/md014).
Sam R: quick update — reproduced the teardown flake, submitting fix in 10m as #4124.
Jorge (release-manager): Good. If #4124 lands and canary passes, we keep Wed window. If not, we'll switch to 'soft slip' message in #announcements: "Ship delayed by up to 24h while we stabilize canary".
Maria P: Suggest wording for announcements: "We are pausing the v1.8.0 rollout due to an infra quota issue and a flaky integration test affecting canary stability. We expect to resume within 24 hours; we'll post updates here." Short and clear.
Alex K: +1. Also include note that users on Dedicated won't be affected by the canary delay.
Jorge (release-manager): Good call. I'll draft announcement if we need it. For now, hold merges to main for features and docs until canary green.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary run for v1.8.0 on region-us-west-2 (pool-small) — queue ID: canary-20260614-77.
Cheng L: pool-small uses fewer GPUs. Might help if quota in us-west-2 is tight. Ops still prefers us-east fallback if we need larger capacity.
Alex K: small pool ok for smoke. If canary fails due to perf we won't accept.
Sam R: #4124 merged, retriggering canary.
CI Bot: [automated] Integ jobs retriggered for canary-queue canary-20260614-77.
Jorge (release-manager): Thanks team. I'll stand by for canary result. If green, Alex please merge version bump and I'll coordinate the announce in #announcements. If red, we'll post the slip message and follow-up with timeline.
Alex K: got it.
Maria P: I'll be on standby to edit the announcement copy.
Cheng L: I'll keep ops looped for fallback GPU provisioning.
Jorge (release-manager): Final note: maintainers — please avoid force pushes to main until I post "merge-open".
Alex K: Roger.
Maria P: 👍
Sam R: fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
Jorge (release-manager): last update: canary is green at 18:17 UTC. Proceeding with merge window in 30m unless any objections.
Alex K: merging in 5.
CI Bot: [automated] Merge #4123 completed. Tags: v1.8.0.
deploy-bot: Canary promote -> gradual rollout scheduled.
Jorge (release-manager): Announce: "v1.8.0 is rolling out now. No customer-facing downtime expected; see release notes for details." Posting in #announcements.
Maria P: Changelog posted and linked in announcement.
Cheng L: ops confirmed no quota issues for the rollout.
Sam R: thanks everyone — great response time.
Jorge (release-manager): Great ship. Closing thread.
